policy: A confirmed semantic bug class is closed only when its content-addressed record is GUARDED and every reproducer/guard reference remains present and machine-checkable.

classes.description: Qualification tests must derive mutable canonical qualification provenance from the registry and ledger instead of hard-coding a previously attested commit, workflow run, or pre-promotion state.

first_observed.signature: test_default_explorer_remains_fail_closed_without_external_artifact: expected False but canonical-static qualification was True

classes.root_cause: Qualification provenance promotion changed canonical source truth from NOT_RUN to PASS, while tests retained historical SHA/run/state oracles. Those tests were coupled to a prior repository epoch instead of the canonical state machine.
classes.closure_rule: Canonical qualification state and provenance are data-derived; a registered guard forbids hard-coded promoted qualification SHA/run oracles in the relevant tests; bug-sweep verifies the content-addressed class and guard references.

classes.description: Qualification failure cleanup must succeed even when execution stops before heartbeat or phase-log creation.

first_observed.signature: gzip: heartbeat.jsonl: No such file or directory

classes.root_cause: The always-run diagnostic finalizer treated an optional heartbeat file as mandatory, allowing cleanup to add a second failure and obscure the primary pre-Lean test failure.
classes.closure_rule: Failure-path finalization is standalone and idempotent, tolerates absent optional evidence, and the always-run workflow wrapper cannot replace a prior failure with a cleanup failure; fault injection is permanent and workflow usage is verified by bug-sweep.

classes.description: Repository scripts executed by an isolated virtual-environment interpreter must preserve the repository root on the Python import path when the package is not installed into that environment.

first_observed.signature: canonical-contract-links: unexpected ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'cace_studio'

classes.root_cause: The PR validator invoked scripts/check_bug_sweep.py by filesystem path with an isolated venv that contained pytest but not CACE. Python set sys.path[0] to scripts/, so the repository package root was unavailable when the sweep imported cace_studio.
classes.closure_rule: The isolated validator explicitly exports the repository root for bug-sweep imports, a policy test requires that safe invocation, and the content-addressed registry verifies both guards remain live.
